_comment: UX.13.3 ratchet (CC-56): per target and surface, the median of 5 Lighthouse runs at one SHA. While a median is over its UX.13.3 budget the gate is baseline x (1 + tolerance) and the budget is a warning; a surface absent here asserts the budget outright. Lower these in every reduction PR; never raise them without a ruling. A metric already at or under its budget is omitted (the budget asserts outright).
tolerance_note: tbt_ms 1.0 as perf/lhci-baseline.json (WC-TW-6c-12): GH runners come in two CPU classes and TBT swings 1.35-1.61x at the same code. Kept at 1.0 by UX.13.3-1 (t_100c9363): with warm-up, app-login TBT median was 91 / 114 / 245 over three runs of the same code (benchmarkIndex ~3200 / ~3800 / ~2600); back to 0.1 per docs/cc-status.md CC-56.
